completion_data.completion_summary: Restored the --hard/routing_hard 5-step precedence resolution in command-route-skill.sh by recovering the verbatim implementation from commit 574bf515a, applying it to the extension-source copy, and byte-syncing it to the deployed copy. Test suite now fully passes (12/12, up from 6/14).

artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for the routing_hard precedence restoration

memory_candidates.content: When restoring a regressed shell script that exists in both an extension-source copy and a deployed copy, always patch the extension-source copy FIRST (source of truth), then byte-sync (cp, not hand-edit) to the deployed copy. Verify with cmp -s / diff -q. Patching deployed-only recreates the regression on the next extension sync (this is exactly how the original command-route-skill.sh --hard precedence bug was introduced in the first place).
